texts: why youre nice but not attractive the psychology that actually explains it lets cut the bs youre a good person youre kind thoughtful maybe even the guy or girl everyone says would make such a great partner someday but heres the thing nobodys actually choosing you and that stings like hell ive spent months digging into this reading research listening to podcasts watching psychology breakdowns on youtube because honestly i was tired of seeing genuinely good people get overlooked while watching chaotic messes get all the attention after diving deep into books like models by mark manson the guy who wrote the subtle art of not giving a fck research on attraction psychology and countless hours of podcasts featuring dating coaches and behavioral scientists i finally get it the problem isnt that youre too nice the problem is what you think nice means society sold us this fairy tale that being nice equals being attractive wrong dead wrong niceness without other qualities is just neutral its the baseline not the destination and heres what nobody wants to tell you because it sounds harsh but you need to hear it step 1 stop using niceness as your entire personality being nice is like having a car with working brakes necessary absolutely exciting hell no when nice is your only selling point youre basically a blank canvas no edge no flavor no polarity attraction needs tension and tension comes from having opinions boundaries and a personality that doesnt bend to please everyone dr robert glovers book no more mr nice guy breaks this down perfectly this book won multiple awards and glover is a licensed psychologist whos worked with thousands of people stuck in this exact pattern he explains how nice people are often people pleasers whove learned to hide their true selves to avoid conflict or rejection and guess what thats the opposite of attractive people are drawn to authenticity not agreeableness the fix start having opinions that might piss people off not to be a jerk but to be real say no sometimes disagree when you actually disagree stop performing niceness and start being genuinely yourself rough edges and all step 2 build something that makes you interesting attraction isnt about being perfect its about being interesting and interesting people have lives that dont revolve around seeking approval this is where most nice but not attractive people fail theyre so focused on being available accommodating and inoffensive that they forget to build a life worth talking about no hobbies that genuinely excite them no goals theyre chasing with obsession no weird interests that make them light up mark mansons models seriously one of the best books on attraction psychology ive ever touched talks about how polarization is key you need to have things about you that some people will love and others will hate thats not a bug its a feature when you try to be likable to everyone you become forgettable to everyone start something learn an instrument badly get obsessed with rock climbing or making sourdough or studying stoic philosophy the content doesnt matter as much as the passion does people are attracted to people who are attracted to life step 3 physical presence matters more than you think nobody wants to say this part out loud but i will your physical presence how you carry yourself your body language matters a ton for attraction and no im not talking about having a six pack or being conventionally hot im talking about posture eye contact taking up space without apologizing for it moving with purpose instead of shrinking yourself theres fascinating research on this amy cuddys ted talk on power posing one of the most watched ted talks ever shows how body language doesnt just communicate confidence to others it actually creates confidence in yourself when you stand tall make eye contact speak clearly your brain literally produces more testosterone and less cortisol nice people tend to make themselves small they slouch they avoid eye contact because they dont want to seem aggressive they speak quietly all of this screams i dont think i deserve to be here and thats repellent hit the gym not to look like a model but to feel strong and take up space confidently practice holding eye contact an extra second longer than feels comfortable stand up straight this isnt vanity its presence step 4 stop seeking validation start creating tension heres the uncomfortable truth when youre too available too eager to please too quick to agree you kill all tension and tension is what creates attraction im not saying play games or be manipulative im saying have standards have boundaries be willing to walk away from people who dont meet your needs the rational male by rollo tomassi digs deep into intersexual dynamics yeah its controversial but the section on maintaining your own frame is gold the core idea when you need someones approval they cant respect you people are attracted to people who have options standards and the confidence to say this isnt working for me that doesnt mean being an asshole it means being someone who values themselves enough not to accept crumbs for anyone struggling to figure out their patterns theres an ai learning app called befreed that pulls from relationship psychology books research papers on attachment theory and expert interviews on dating dynamics you tell it your specific situation like wanting to build confidence in dating as an introvert and it creates a structured learning plan with audio content you can customize from quick 10minute overviews to 40minute deep dives the app includes insights from books like attached and models plus research on boundarysetting and selfworth you can adjust the depth based on your schedule and choose different voice styles the sarcastic narrator actually makes dense psychology easier to digest worth checking out if structured learning helps you internalize concepts better than random youtube binges step 5 develop social proof and status attraction is partially social were wired to find people attractive who others find valuable its called preselection and its backed by evolutionary psychology if youre always alone always available always the one reaching out it signals low social value but if you have friends hobbies a social life that doesnt revolve around potential romantic interests suddenly you become more interesting join group activities build friendships be seen as someone who adds value to social situations this isnt fake its about genuinely building a life where youre connected and engaged matthew husseys youtube channel is incredible for this hes a dating coach who breaks down social dynamics without the toxic masculinity bs his video on how to be the most interesting person in the room changed my entire approach to social situations step 6 embrace masculine or feminine polarity this ones going to ruffle feathers but whatever attraction often involves polarity that doesnt mean rigid gender roles or toxic stereotypes it means embodying certain energies if youre someone who identifies as more masculine that means being decisive having direction being protective of your time and energy if you identify as more feminine that means being receptive expressive flowing when youre too neutral too accommodating too shapeless theres no polarity to create charge david deidas the way of the superior man explores this its intense and not for everyone but the concepts around masculine purpose are powerful the basic idea masculine energy is about mission and direction feminine energy is about presence and emotion most nice but not attractive people have neutralized themselves into having neither figure out what energy you naturally embody and lean into it stop trying to be everything to everyone step 7 fix your scarcity mindset if you treat every potential romantic interest like theyre your last chance at happiness youre cooked that desperation seeps through everything your texts your conversations your body language scarcity mindset makes you clingy available 247 afraid to disagree or have boundaries and thats the opposite of attractive the fix build abundance not by dating a million people but by having a life so full of purpose hobbies friendships and goals that any one person cant make or break your happiness atomic habits by james clear a new york times bestseller thats sold millions isnt specifically about dating but its about building systems that make you into someone youre proud to be when youre actively becoming a better version of yourself every day scarcity mindset dissolves naturally use the finch app for building daily habits that arent about attracting anyone else but about becoming someone you respect it gamifies self improvement in a way that actually sticks the real talk being nice isnt the problem being only nice having no edge no boundaries no life outside of seeking approval thats the problem youre not unattractive because youre kind youre unattractive because youve made yourself invisible trying not to offend anyone the good news this is fixable every single step here is about building genuine confidence presence and a life worth living do that and attraction follows naturally not because youre manipulating anyone but because youve become someone even you would want to be around stop waiting for someone to choose you start choosing yourself first

master to join us for a longterm dd 5e campaign on roll20discord our table is highly roleplayfocused with a strong love for character interaction exploration and narrative depth were the kind of group that happily spends hours incharacter developing relationships uncovering lore and following story threads combat is absolutely part of the gamebut its sprinkled in thoughtfully rather than being the primary focus players range from moderately experienced to very familiar with 5e system style dd 5e with some existing homebrew heavy emphasis on roleplay and exploration characterdriven storytelling over pure optimization campaign premise the party is enrolled at an adventuring academy the campaign would ideally begin during the partys final year at the academy giving space to build on established group dynamics deepen character arcs and relationships complete missions and assignments tied to the academy explore the broader world through the lens of this institution the setting characters and some narrative groundwork are already establishedbut where the story goes from there is entirely up to the dm and we are open to adjusting these as well were excited to collaborate and give you room to shape the plot themes and longterm direction tone themes were comfortable exploring darker or more mature themes when they serve the story but were not looking for a campaign that becomes relentlessly grim or depressing we believe good storytelling has highs and lowsmoments of tension loss and consequence balanced by hope growth humor and meaningful victories at the end of the day we want the game to remain engaging collaborative and enjoyable schedule weekday sessions except tuesday 700 pm est start time sessions expected to run 34 hours flexible what were looking for in a dm some dming experience and comfort running 5e communicative and open to feedback enjoys working with existing lore and homebrew invested in collaborative storytelling someone we can genuinely welcome into our friend groupnot just our dm we value respect creativity and enthusiasm for storytelling this is a table where player agency matters communication is important and everyone is here to and your car makes noises youve never heard before and this friday its looking like a wind chill of 35 degrees when temperatures plummet like this most of us are focused on staying warm layering up and avoiding the outdoors as much as humanly possible but heres the thing while youre bundled up on the couch your homes plumbing is fighting its own battle against the freeze and if those pipes lose your beautiful floors could be the ultimate casualty the frozen pipe problem nobody wants to think about have you ever woken up to the nightmare of water gushing from a burst pipe if you have you know its one of the most stressful experiences a homeowner can face if you havent lets keep it that way heres what happens when water freezes inside your pipes it expands that expansion creates enormous agrasen ki baoli echoes of ancient waters in modern delhi x200b historical origins and legends agrasen ki baoli nestled in the bustling heart of new delhi stands as a testament to indias ingenious water management systems from centuries past this stepwell also known as ugrasen ki baoli is believed to trace its roots back to the legendary maharaja agrasen a figure from the mahabharata era who is revered as the ancestor of the agrawal community according to folklore agrasen was a wise and benevolent king who established numerous settlements and infrastructure for his people including water reservoirs to combat the arid conditions of northern india the baoli is said to have been constructed during his reign serving not only as a source of water but also as a symbol of prosperity and communal harmony however historical evidence suggests that the current structure was rebuilt or renovated during the medieval period specifically in the 14th century under the tughlaq dynasty this reconstruction aligns with the architectural styles prevalent during the delhi sultanate blending indigenous indian elements with influences from islamic design the absence of definitive inscriptions or records adds an air of mystery fueling debates among historians about its exact origins some scholars argue that the site may have predated agrasen possibly linked to earlier vedic or premauryan water harvesting traditions the agrawal communitys involvement in its upkeep and restoration highlights their cultural pride and connection to this ancestral monument over time the baoli has evolved from a functional utility to a protected heritage site guarded by the archaeological survey of india since the mid20th century its location near connaught place amidst modern skyscrapers creates a striking contrast between ancient ingenuity and contemporary urban life legends abound about the baolis mystical properties with tales of it being haunted by spirits or possessing black waters that and enhance overall wellbeing one of the most effective practices that has stood the test of time is meditation specifically mindfulness meditation exercises can transform your life by increasing awareness reducing stress and fostering emotional resilience in this article we explore practical mindfulness meditation exercises and how they can improve your daily life what is mindfulness meditation mindfulness meditation is a mental practice that encourages individuals to focus on the present moment without judgment unlike other forms of meditation that may involve chanting or visualizations mindfulness emphasizes observing thoughts emotions and bodily sensations as they occur by practicing mindfulness regularly you develop a heightened sense of awareness improved emotional regulation and a deeper connection to your inner self mindfulness does not require any special equipment or location it can be practiced anywhere from your office desk to a quiet park the simplicity and accessibility of mindfulness meditation make it an ideal tool for improving your mental and physical health benefits of mindfulness meditation mindfulness meditation offers a range of benefits that extend beyond mental clarity here are some of the key advantages 1 reduces stress and anxiety one of the most wellknown benefits of mindfulness meditation is stress reduction by focusing on the present moment and letting go of negative thought patterns you can calm your mind and decrease the production of stress hormones over time this practice can lead to reduced anxiety and improved emotional stability 2 improves concentration and focus regular mindfulness meditation enhances your ability to concentrate and maintain attention by training the mind to focus on the breath sensations or specific tasks you can improve productivity and mental clarity in everyday activities 3 enhances emotional health mindfulness meditation encourages selfawareness and selfcompassion by observing your thoughts and emotions without judgment you develop a better understanding of your inner experiences this can lead to improved emotional regulation reduced symptoms of depression and greater overall happiness 4 supports physical health mindfulness meditation is also linked to several physical health benefits studies suggest that it can lower blood pressure improve sleep quality and boost the immune system additionally by reducing stress mindfulness can decrease the risk of stressrelated illnesses mindfulness meditation exercises to try here are practical mindfulness meditation exercises that you can integrate into your daily routine 1 breathing meditation breathing meditation is one of the simplest yet most powerful mindfulness exercises sit comfortably with your back straight close your eyes and focus on your breath pay attention to the sensation of air entering and leaving your nostrils or the rise and fall of your chest and abdomen when your mind wanders gently bring your attention back to your breath practicing this exercise for 510 minutes daily can significantly reduce stress and enhance mental clarity 2 body scan meditation body scan meditation involves focusing on different parts of your body in a sequential manner lie down comfortably and bring your awareness to your toes gradually moving upward to your head notice any sensations tension or discomfort without trying to change them this exercise promotes relaxation reduces physical tension and fosters a deeper connection between mind and body 3 walking meditation walking meditation combines physical movement with mindfulness walk slowly and deliberately paying attention to each step the sensation of your feet touching the ground and the movement of your body observe your surroundings with full awareness walking meditation can be particularly beneficial for those who find it challenging to sit still for long periods 4 mindful eating mindful eating encourages you to focus fully on the act of eating take small bites chew slowly and notice the taste texture and aroma of each morsel avoid distractions like television or smartphones this exercise can improve digestion reduce overeating and cultivate a healthier relationship with food 5 guided meditation guided meditation involves listening to a recorded meditation led by an instructor these sessions often include instructions on breathing visualization or affirmations guided meditation can be particularly helpful for beginners who are learning to practice mindfulness and maintain focus tips for body scans walking meditation mindful eating and guided sessions into your daily routine you can reduce stress improve focus and foster emotional resilience meditation is not just a relaxation here in this subreddit lots of people told me to go play prime remastered to understand why they are so mad now that ive played prime remastered i wanted to come back and tell people what i think especially since so many people told me to go play it so that i understand the issues with prime 4 it took a bit of configuration in the options at first but once i got the dual stick control option working alongside the gyro camera it felt more like how prime 4 felt once i got the controls right it felt a lot better i also had to get used to using the dpad for the scan visor but after a while i detective to work out what had happened on this planet the more i played the more i became addicted to just scanning one more room for clues to push forward when i got stuck backtracking for a little why is the tradwife lifestyle being romanticised in the west despite the risks of financial dependence im curious about the tradwife movement that seems to be getting popular in some western countries and i wanted to share my perspective as an indian woman so in india we dont really have a tradwife movement as such its more like lifestyle i grew up in a conservative indian family my grandmother and my mother both had arranged marriages and never really worked outside the home this is still very common especially in rural india even among women of my generation and because of that ive seen the real version of what people now call a tradwife not the aesthetic contentcreator version they show in media in the west but the everyday reality in my family there was a single income and four people to support money was tight my mother made a lot of sacrifices she rarely bought nice things for herself the budget was always strict and most of her energy went into managing the household and raising us her work was largely invisible and rarely appreciated she was also financially dependent on my father and i could see how that affected her freedom and independence there were many things she wanted to do in life but simply couldnt because there was no money of her own and no space to explore herself beyond being a wife and a mother another thing i observed and this is very important was loneliness my mother often felt lonely she made her children her entire life because there wasnt much else she didnt really pursue hobbies interests or personal growth part of that was the society she came from but the structure itself didnt allow much room for individuality in my extended family ive also seen women stuck in unhappy marriages divorce is highly stigmatised in india yes but another main reason they couldnt leave was financial dependence starting from scratch at 30 or 35 with no work experience and no savings is terrifying one example close to me a cousin in a marriage whose husband fell in love with someone else after seven years shes now 33 and starting over studying trying to build a career from scratch thankfully there are no children involved but its still incredibly hard ive seen how vulnerable this position can be because i have grown up seeing all that i personally never romanticised this lifestyle i worked very hard went into a stem field and im financially independent im not married yet but i do want a partner and children in the future i just feel that my life compared to my mothers generation has more options and freedom also a sense of self so when i see the tradwife movement online especially when its presented as very aesthetic and idealised i feel confused many of the women promoting it are actually earning money through content creation which already makes them not financially dependent in the traditional sense what also bothers me is when working women are bashed or ambition is portrayed as something negative i dont think wanting a family and wanting to cultivate your mind skills and independence are opposites you can want children and still want to grow intellectually and emotionally im not saying staying at home is wrong maybe if someone has a very supportive emotionally mature partner strong financial security and real autonomy it can work but from what ive seen firsthand its rarely as simple or as beautiful as it looks online so my genuine question to people in the west why do you think the tradwife movement is becoming popular now
